reference: Selected seven-model broadcast closure, protected before this round; SHA dcb3a8d2ec3fbc1d2308c85303a995f6102112d4976e466942556626223a05ce.
hypothesis: A local jersey-color classifier may correct wrong tracking team assignments near the ball and supply independent H/A geometry for missed short possessions.
privacy: No hosted visual model, no image display or hosted competition extracts. Decode tactical video and compute color statistics locally. All derived arrays/checkpoints stay under ignored data/. No manual labels or final-frame patches.
weak_color_labels: Track team metadata only, not possession targets. Use isolated in-pitch moving players; exclude public frames11185..18684 plus250 and all24 frozen windows plus250. These are noisy proxy labels.

frame_sampling.sampling: Choose validation frames randomly without replacement from eligible grid. Remove all training candidates within250frames of those validation frames; choose240 remaining with same RNG. Reject if insufficient.

crop.height_estimate: Largest local homography Jacobian singular value in pixels/metre times1.75. Crop torso x+/-.22height and y[-.85,-.35]height above projected feet. Clip only to image; reject clipped or implausible crops.
crop.bounds: Body height4..90 at960px; torso>=12pixels; >=6 nongrass pixels. Grass mask G>1.15R and G>1.05B.
crop.training_player_filter: Position>=10m from goal lines,>=3m from touchlines; speed .5..12m/s; nearest other observed player>=3m.

features: Normalized HSV12x3x3 histogram plus RGB mean/std and channel .1/.5/.9 quantiles, plus nongrass pixel fraction. No time, position, identity or metadata label in the classifier.

color_models.name: logistic
color_models.parameters: StandardScaler fit on weak training crops; LogisticRegression C1,class_weight balanced,max_iter1000,seed42

feasibility.ordering: profile1 logistic,profile1 forest,profile.8 logistic,profile.8 forest,profile1.25 logistic,profile1.25 forest; first passing. Report all6 regardless.
feasibility.gates: >=250 valid weak validation crops per team; >=.5 valid-crop fraction; balanced accuracy>=.90; confidence>=.8 coverage>=.50 and accuracy>=.95. If none passes, no public possession model fitting in this plan.

development_if_feasible.frames: Tactical10935..18935 every5frames; no more than5frames interpolation. Never fill across missing crops or source gaps. Padded19060 and18935 constructions must agree on public features.
development_if_feasible.geometry: Use confident color-assigned players only for independent nearest-team geometry; keep original distances as reference. Fixed past/future temporal summaries<=125frames plus<=5sample interpolation.
development_if_feasible.fitting: Public training-only binary fast and joint-frame heads on existing folds, seed42 screen; original7-model reference unchanged.
development_if_feasible.decoders: Live ownership replacement inside unchanged reference live episodes; conservative8..125frame proposals requiring source contact and original opposite flanks. Keep all referenceD. Full head/decoder details must be frozen before public possession scores are computed.

promotion: Before promotion require a prospectively frozen unchanged finalist across all9 seed/protocol pairs, no primary or D regression, buffered primary+.04 and at least one additional short IoU.5 match, acceptable MacroF1/false-possession counts, source/input/model/padding parity, reproducible valid full CSV and independent review. No threshold changes masquerading as passing this plan.
limitations: Weak team-label agreement is not human jersey accuracy. Same-match adaptive public development is not independent/private accuracy or proof of maximum score.
